eyebrow: A research program around human ability
title: Human-Adaptive Interaction
statement: Technology should adapt to what people can perceive, process, and do—without adding more burden than benefit.
readingHint: Each row follows one human capacity through the same repeating cycle.

stages.label: Understand
stages.prompt: Understand who the person is, what they can do now, and what the task requires.

stages.label: Respond
stages.prompt: Choose how—and whether—the system should adapt.

stages.label: Verify & Learn
stages.prompt: Measure benefit and cost, then use the evidence to shape the next cycle.

lanes.label: Perceive
lanes.subtitle: Align the senses
lanes.story: Understand perceptual limits, shape multisensory feedback, and verify that the result remains comfortable and accessible.

cards.title: Perceptual Limits
cards.caption: Characterize detection thresholds and sensory conflict across people and contexts.

cards.title: Multisensory Feedback
cards.caption: Coordinate visual, vestibular, tactile, thermal, auditory, and olfactory cues.

cards.title: Comfort & Access
cards.caption: Evaluate presence, sickness, stability, and visual exploration—not only technical range.

lanes.label: Process
lanes.subtitle: Fit attention
lanes.story: Understand cognitive demand, adapt interfaces and information, and verify effects on attention, decisions, and trust.

cards.title: Load & Demand
cards.caption: Measure how workload, context, and information needs change touch, gaze, and behavior.

cards.title: Adaptive UI & Information
cards.caption: Adapt layout, timing, and contextual communication to the person and the moment.

cards.title: Attention & Trust
cards.caption: Account for distraction, safety, clarity, and trust when deciding whether adaptation helps.

lanes.label: Act
lanes.subtitle: Partner with the body
lanes.story: Understand intent and physical demand, deliver body-aware assistance, and verify performance and safety.

cards.title: Intent & Biomechanics
cards.caption: Model movement intent and person-specific joint and muscle demands.

cards.title: Haptics & Assistance
cards.caption: Translate task forces and sensed performance into stimulation, guidance, or device support.

cards.title: Performance & Safety
cards.caption: Test task accuracy, movement quality, distraction, stability, and the cost of physical intervention.
